next.reason: KEPT: 1985 status 10 when a sequential READ finds no next logical record because the end of file is reached or it is the first sequential READ of an absent optional input file; §2023:9.1.13.4 GR1 keeps both ("NEXT was specified or implied and the end of the physical file has been reached"; "a sequential READ statement is attempted for the first time on a file described as optional and the physical file is not present"), §2023:14.9.30.4 GR21 sets '10' for those positions and GR24 makes the READ unsuccessful when "the at end condition exists". The PREVIOUS case needs 2023-only syntax; EC-I-O-AT-END is set only if enabled.
